visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a golden-brown, sliced Tamagoyaki (Japanese rolled omelet) resting on a light yellow plate decorated with red strawberry patterns. The texture of the egg is visible, appearing moist and layered. (2) A close-up transition shows several round, seaweed-flecked rice crackers (Senbei) on a separate plate. (3) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a black tank top, sits at a wooden dining table in a brightly lit kitchen-living area. She uses red chopsticks to eat and gestures with her hands while smiling. (4) A hand holds up a large, metallic gold-colored bag of 'Ogura Sansou' brand rice crackers in front of a domestic background featuring a kitchen counter and appliances. (5) The bag is opened, and the camera focuses on the crackers inside; one cracker is pulled out to show its thin, crispy surface and soy sauce glaze. (6) In the kitchen, the woman places several crackers into a clear plastic Ziploc bag and uses a glass jar as a mallet to crush them into coarse pieces. (7) In a metal mixing bowl, three eggs are cracked, followed by the addition of dark soy sauce, white sugar, and a splash of milk from a carton. The ingredients are whisked together manually. (8) The crushed cracker pieces are poured into the egg mixture and stirred until evenly distributed. (9) On an induction cooktop, a square black Tamagoyaki pan is heated. The egg-cracker mixture is poured in small batches, cooked briefly, and then rolled toward one side using black chopsticks and a spatula. (10) A layer of white shredded cheese is sprinkled onto the semi-cooked egg before the final roll is completed. (11) The completed, large-sized egg roll is placed onto the strawberry-themed plate and sliced into thick pieces. (12) The woman carries the plate to a dining table where a man in a grey t-shirt is sitting; he uses chopsticks to taste the food while the woman watches. (13) The man looks at the camera with a surprised and impressed facial expression. (14) The woman returns to her seat, eating the egg roll and talking directly to the camera with high energy.
